title: Matter — Add Member Response
description: Success response for POST /api/pact/matters/{id}/members (§24.6). The operation is idempotent: 'ensure this principal is a member', not 'create a membership'. `added` is true only when the member was newly created; a repeat add — at the same role OR a different one — returns added:false with the EXISTING role and emits no event. Fields are flat camelCase to match the deployed wire contract pinned by #30/#31; there is no nested `member` wrapper. Ratified via RFC #32.

matterId.description: The Matter the principal is a member of. Prefix `mtr_`.

added.description: true = the member was newly created and pact.matter.member-added was emitted. false = the principal was already a member; no state change and NO event. A dropped-ACK retry therefore returns added:false rather than an error.

role.description: The member's role AS STORED. When added is false this is the EXISTING role, which may differ from the role requested — add-member never changes an existing member's role (§24.6, RFC #32 option (a)). A caller that needs to know whether its requested role took effect MUST compare this value against what it sent.

eventId.description: Id of the emitted pact.matter.member-added event. Present only when added is true — an idempotent repeat emits no event, so this key is absent.
